name: Peatlands and Natura Community Engagement Scheme
summary: Competitive fund for community and local organisations running peatland and Natura 2000 site projects such as conservation management, monitoring, invasive species and fire control, funding 80% of costs. The 2026 call is closed; the page does not say whether it recurs.

amount.note: Up to 80% of project costs; maximum EUR 20,000 for non-Natura peatland sites

eligibility.rule: Is not a local authority or commercial project
If outside Natura 2000, is a peatland site
Can be delivered in a realistic timeframe during 2026
Does not solely benefit an individual, use unrelated equipment or generate income
Does not include access or road improvement measures or drains on bogs used for turf cutting or commercial uses
Carries out improvement works only when necessary, not ordinary maintenance

documents: Preferred supplier quotations for goods and services
Proof of legal status of the group or organisation
Written consent of affected landowners, if applicable

status.quote: is now open for applications for 2026 with a closing date of 09 January 2026

deadline.quote: is now open for applications for 2026 with a closing date of 09 January 2026

applicant_types.quote: The Scheme aims to encourage communities, local organisations and other interested parties to become involved in the enhancement of their natural surrounding areas

access.quote: Details of the Terms and Conditions of the Scheme and Application Form needed to apply are available via the links below

window.quote: This is a competitive fund, with up to €800,000 available in 2026.

amount.quote: Category 1 - Natura 2000 sites (SAC / SPA) The maximum grant available is 80% of the costs of the project to a maximum of €40,000 Category 2 - Non-Natura Peatland sites (incl. NHA and undesignated sites) The maximum grant available is 80% of the cost of the project to a maximum of €20,000

co_finance_required.quote: The remaining project costs must be funded through match funding in the form of financial contributions, voluntary and in-kind hours or donations.

effort.quote: Applications will be accepted for 2026 projects until 9th January 2026.
The NPWS will assess and recommend applications for consideration for funding under the scheme.

eligibility.quote: Proof of the legal status of any community group or organisation must be submitted with an application.
Please note that local authority or commercial projects are not eligible for funding under this Scheme.
Applications for sites that are not Natura 2000 will only be considered if they are peatland sites.
Projects funded under the scheme should be commenced as soon as practicable and must be capable of being delivered in a realistic time-frame and during the 2026 calendar year.
 Projects that solely benefit an individual  Equipment, unless directly associated with the project  Income generating projects
Funding for access or road improvement measures or drains on bogs being used for turf cutting or commercial uses will not be eligible for funding under this scheme.
Improvement works must be necessary and not merely ordinary maintenance or of a kind which the applicants could reasonably be expected to do for themselves.

co_finance.quote: Grants available under Category 2 will be between €500 and €20,000, with the maximum grant available being 80% of the costs of the project. The remaining project costs must be funded through match funding in the form of financial contributions, voluntary and in-kind hours or donations.

after_award.quote: A completion report will be required on completion of the project.

documents.quote: For physical works a method statement must be also submitted appropriate to the scale and nature of the project.

Project timelines and milestones should also be provided. Quotations must be supplied from the supplier for specific goods/materials/services. Goods catalogues will not be accepted as quotations. Please submit the preferred quotation with your application but retain on file other quotes received for audit purposes.
Proof of the legal status of any community group or organisation must be submitted with an application.
This written consent must be submitted with the application form
